title: The Dog Night, 2000
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A year since the dumpster. A wordless daily. It will run every November.

panels.composition: The dumpster behind SMALL WOOD LANES at night. The chain-link. The bare bulb. Nothing tied there. WOOD and BARNABY standing where the dog was.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog standing behind a bowling alley at night in front of a rusted dumpster and chain-link fence under a bare bulb, brush-pen black and white, no words

panels.composition: The chain-link. The spot. A wet ring of rope, left from something else.

image.prompt: close-up of a chain-link fence with a wet loop of rope tied to it, no words

panels.composition: The dog looking up at Wood.

image.prompt: a small dog looking up at a young man who looks down at it, night, bare bulb, no words

panels.composition: Walking away, the two of them, the neon sign lit above the roofline: SMALL WOOD LANES, all letters on.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away from behind a bowling alley with its neon sign fully lit above the roofline, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The Dog Night fixture: wordless, every November. All letters lit — for now.
